column1: add_credits,"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_credits(p_user_id uuid, p_amount integer, p_description text DEFAULT 'manual topup'::text)
update public.profiles set credits = credits + p_amount where id = p_user_id
insert into public.credit_transactions (user_id, amount, type, description)
select credits into v_balance from public.profiles where id = p_user_id
admin_email_by_user_id,CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_email_by_user_id(p_user_id uuid)
if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'not_authorized'
select email into em from auth.users where id = p_user_id limit 1
admin_user_id_by_email,CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_user_id_by_email(p_email text)
select id into uid from auth.users where lower(email) = lower(trim(p_email)) limit 1
deduct_credits,CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deduct_credits(p_user_id uuid, p_amount integer, p_tool text DEFAULT NULL::text)
update public.profiles set credits = credits - p_amount where id = p_user_id
insert into public.credit_transactions (user_id, amount, type, tool, description)
select credits into v_balance from public.profiles where id = p_user_id
refund_credits,CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refund_credits(p_user_id uuid, p_amount integer, p_tool text DEFAULT NULL::text)
update public.profiles set credits = credits + p_amount where id = p_user_id
insert into public.credit_transactions (user_id, amount, type, tool, description)
select credits into v_balance from public.profiles where id = p_user_id
